name: A Blade to Start With
about: Jessamy hung up her sword years ago and keeps a rack of spares for newcomers. She gives one away to anyone who asks.
offer: New in town? You look like you have never held a proper blade.
I hung mine up years ago, but I keep a rack of spares for people like you. Here, this one is light and quick.
thanks: Swing it like you mean it.

name: Andrin's Harvest Basket
about: Andrin's knees gave out before the harvest. He needs carrots and potatoes for the winter cellar, and the Farm grows both.
offer: Oh, my knees. Forty years on the land and now I cannot bend down to a carrot.
Could you fill my basket? Sixteen carrots and sixteen potatoes. The Farm south-east of the village grows both, and nobody minds you picking.
I will make it worth your while.
remind: Sixteen carrots and sixteen potatoes, friend. The Farm is south-east of the village.
thanks: A full basket! The cellar will be full this winter. Take this, and thank you.

name: Stand Your Ground
about: Duke Harrow held the Graveyard wall in his day. He wants to see you thin out the zombies there before he believes you can fight.
offer: When I was your age we held the Graveyard wall with nothing but spears.
Fifteen zombies. Go and put fifteen of them back in the ground, and then we can talk like soldiers.
And bank your coins first. The dead are not polite about your purse.
remind: Fifteen Graveyard zombies. The Graveyard is east of the village. Take them one at a time.
thanks: Fifteen! You will do. Here, a soldier's pay.

name: Two Letters
about: Lorcan the courier has twisted his ankle with two letters still in his bag: one for Old Wenna at the Graveyard chapel, one for Castellan Merrow at the Old Keep.

steps.text: Deliver a letter to Old Wenna (Graveyard chapel)
steps.note: Old Wenna takes the letter and tucks it into her shawl.

steps.text: Deliver a letter to Castellan Merrow (Old Keep)
steps.note: Castellan Merrow breaks the seal and nods.

offer: Ow, ow. Turned my ankle on the well steps, and I still have two letters to deliver.
One for Old Wenna at the Graveyard chapel, one for Castellan Merrow up at the Old Keep.
Would you run them for me? The Hub Map shows both places.
remind: The letters, friend! Old Wenna at the chapel, and the Castellan at the Old Keep.
thanks: Both delivered? You are faster than I ever was. Here is my fee, every coin of it.

name: A Connoisseur's Eye
about: Ottoline Vane only deals with people of taste: show her a reforged item in your hand, and the Village Affinity Talisman (the Adventurer sells it) in your Accessory Bag.

steps.text: Hold a reforged item when you talk to her

offer: You may approach. I only deal with people of taste, you understand.
Show me a reforged piece in your hand. The Blacksmith in the Mining District will reforge anything for a fee.
And a Village Affinity Talisman in your bag. The Adventurer sells them. Every resident of standing carries one.
remind: A reforged piece in your hand, and the Village Affinity Talisman in your bag. I can wait. Briefly.
thanks: Well. You do have an eye after all. A small token of my regard.

name: Show Me Your Pet!
about: Wilf wants a pet more than anything and is not allowed one. He would love to meet yours, and wants you to ask the Pet Sitter how pets grow.

steps.text: Have a pet summoned when you talk to him
Ask the Pet Sitter about pet upgrades

offer: Have you got a pet? Mum says I am not allowed one until I am older.
Can I meet yours? Summon it and come back! Your pets are in the SkyBlock Menu.
And can you ask the Pet Sitter at Pet Care how they get bigger? I am too shy.
remind: Did you bring your pet? And did you ask the Pet Sitter? Pet Care is the birch house in the village.
thanks: It is SO cute! And they really grow up? Here, you can have my savings. I was saving for a pet anyway.

name: The Lazy Miner's Quota
about: Aurel is supposed to dig his coal quota and would rather not. Mine some in the Coal Mine and bring him a share.

steps.text: Mine 20 Coal in the Coal Mine

offer: Say, you look like you have strong arms. I have a coal quota to make and a very important nap to take.
Mine twenty coal back there in the tunnel and bring me ten of it. You keep the rest. I pay, honest.
remind: Twenty mined, ten for me. The coal is in the tunnel behind me. Zzz...
thanks: Ten coal! The foreman will think I worked all day. Here, you earned it.

name: First Harvest
about: Prosper needs a hand with the wheat before the contest. Harvest some on the Farm.
offer: The contest is coming and the wheat is not going to cut itself.
Harvest thirty-two wheat in the fields here and come back. Keep what you cut.
remind: Thirty-two wheat, then come and see me. Any hoe will do; even your fist works.
thanks: Good clean cutting. You have a farmer's hands. Here's your wage.

name: The Restless
about: The zombie villagers that rise at night were townsfolk once. Old Wenna asks you to lay five of them to rest and bring her what is left.

steps.text: Lay 5 Zombie Villagers to rest (they rise at night)

offer: The ones in the brown smocks, that rise at night. They were townsfolk once. I knew some of them.
Lay five of them to rest for me. And bring me ten pieces of what is left, so I can bury it properly.
remind: Five of the zombie villagers. They only rise at night. And ten pieces of flesh for the burying.
thanks: Thank you, child. They can sleep now. Take this, I have no use for coins.

name: Wolves at the Sister Fort
about: The Ruins on the hill at the far west of the Hub were the Old Keep's sister fort. Wolves live there now (and in the Wilderness); the Castellan wants them thinned. Combat III is recommended.
offer: The Ruins on the hill were our sister fort. The wolves took it while I was still a squire.
Thin them out. Five will do for now. Be careful of the old grey ones: they are not like the others.
remind: Five wolves. The Ruins are on the hill at the far west of the Hub, past the Colosseum; the Wilderness has a few too. Mind the old grey ones.
thanks: Five fewer wolves on the walls. The Keep thanks you, and so do I.
